coverage.observation: Inspected a coral toaster with slot, lever, feet and a simple face; its identity remains consistent between counter and launch shots.
Toast moves upward from the slot as the toaster changes scale; the sampled sequence shows the launch direction. Frame sampling alone does not rate playback smoothness.
The same crust-and-crumb toast shape floats above a curved planet on a star field, making the absurd toast-moon outcome visible.
